Hi v/startrek! I want to get into Star Trek, due to an interest of finding something new and different than what I usually watch. I've seen the enormous fandom, its cultural impact upon Sci-Fi, so I decided, "Why not?"

There are so many Star Trek series with the Original, Deep Space 9, The Next Generation, Voyager, etc. Anyone know which series is the best place to start for a person new to the franchise? I'd appreciate any answers.

I want to get into Star Trek, where do I start?

You can pretty well start with any of them. They're all reasonably self-contained and don't require a lot of prior Trek knowledge. I started with Voyager (I wouldn't recommend it). If you don't mind the outdated effects, I'd recommend The Next Generation, it has what most of Trek is about (exploration on a ship, betterment of humanity, solving problems with brains/science/technology) and it's pretty well liked among fans (many fans dislike a particular series for one reason or another).

Thanks for the recommendation! I feel overwhelmed at how many Trek series there are, I dunno where to start.

I'll check out The Next Generation first, I guess. It does look like everyone has a reason to hate on a certain series.

I'll preface my answer by saying that I'm a Star Wars fan, not really a Star Trek fan. So my knowledge may be a bit lacking compared to others.

In order of release, you have The Original Series (TOS), The Animated Series (TAS), The Next Generation (TNG), Deep Space Nine (DS9), Voyager (VOY), and Enterprise (ENT). Most or all should still be available for free if you have Amazon Prime.

Personally, TOS is a bit cheesy. Like Gilligan's Island or the Brady Bunch. If you're over 40, you may enjoy it. TAS is even worse and reminds me of Scooby Doo but older, not funny, and boring. TNG is my favorite of them all. It gets a bit campy at times but it's bearable for the most part. DS9 is a soap opera in space. VOY tried to be like TNG but somehow failed along the way. I would pick this as my second choice. ENT could have been good but it felt so forced with everything they did after the first season it almost came out worse than TOS.

TL/DR - Start with The Next Generation. Go with Voyager or the original series if you still enjoy it.

TOS is my favorite. I really enjoyed TAS as well. It's actually a lot of fun. I'm the kind of person who enjoys media in the chronological order it was released.

Flipping through Wikipedia for names, so bear with me. TOS has some great freaking episodes. Balance of Terror, Space Seed, The City on the Edge of Forever, The Doomsday Machine, The Enterprise Incident, The Tholian Web, and Let That Be Your Last Battlefield are all standouts. There are episodes that are just fun, like the ones with Harry Mudd, and The Trouble with Tribbles.

I wouldnt have said this in the past, but start with TOS, but not just TOS. There is an ongoing podcast, analyzing the episodes, one per week, its currently in season 3 of TNG. They do a pretty good job of not crossing the timeline. So watch with them, I had seen TOS before and didnt like it, then watched it again with these guys and got so much more out of it, its really pretty good. Here is their website. http://www.missionlogpodcast.com/

Anyway, they arent exactly unbiased, being fans they try to find good when there really isnt any, and at my most cynical I think this is Rod Roddenberry trying to bump viewership of star trek to increase his royalty payments from it, and at times its a bit cheesy, like 70s variety show cheesy, but overall its pretty good, I am enjoying going back through the entirety of star trek with them.

They are going a bit out of order, going at it series by series, TOS -> TNG -> DS9, ets, ignoring the overlap between the shows, but it doesnt seem to hurt things much, I can see how it would be easier that way.

Without the podcast, TOS seemed lame to me (mostly bad effects, is almost like a 1920s western in its moral simplicity if you dont look for nuance) TAS is an extension of TOS and requires knowledge of it, but dont skip TAS, its surprisingly good, TNG and DS9 take a couple seasons to really get good, Voyager seems to drop off over its run (on a binge watch I literally stopped watching in season 5, I found I just wasnt enjoying it, it became a chore) and I feel like you would miss too many injokes if you started at ENT.

Honestly, if you just want to test the waters, I would start at the rebooted movie, its a short fast intro, you wont fullyenjoy the movie til you watch it again later, but you will probably do that anyway.
I would start with TNG-imho the best of them all.After that you will decide for yourself.

Interlaced fingers I laid in grasses dark as algae
Hands behind head, scapulae on cold planetary Earth
The horizon rounded like marbled abalone
Time twixt 1 and 2 but not between
Firefly sparklers danced blowing winds of glow
Heart throbbing
"They're coming."

Fire in the sky
Spotlights over silent trees who'll never tell
Shelter a distant comfort, I exposed naked and clothed
If my heart throbbed once more, the predators would know
These ancient martians from chiliads past
Their abduction of me
A polysemy

An argonaut brought I to sneezy fields cloaked in darkness
I itched for them like brush and bugs irritated my skin
Hadn't I asked for visitors before I dreamt?
To them I'm worth but my accouterment
Would they leave a sacred symbol, an emblem?
Sidereal beings with puppet skin

I thought of men like cattle
Planet Earth about to be recycled

Could I be their vivisection?
Cover me with skin-colored film so I cannot breath
Pry my eyes open so I cannot see
Would I turn jaundice from terror?
A machine comes down to pierce through pus
Would it see constellations in my eyes or
Golden daisies floating through galaxies bursting with sunshine
Centered by a big black hole
Which is an iris where I myself reside a prisoner
Where humanity falls inside and
My limbal rings large as Saturn's disk?

Catching wanderers astray
Like a spider catches its prey
Spins a web, dances around my heart
Sobbing inside only beats the heart harder

I beat like human cities
Before they become pools of ashes

Now they see me
I feel noticed like a boy in charmed by his mother's love

Now they see me
My spirit took me here, to dark dusty dirt roads
The insects pay no mind
So I characterize them as alien

Now they see me
The soaring treetops watch with glee
As objects bathe me in sickeningly heavenly light
Perhaps a death? Such delight!
Baptized by dark spirits
Objectified by an inhumane will
Please, take me
Please, take me
